headline: A big catch for the Chiefs!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a short pass to T.Kelce, who caught the ball and ran 16 yards for a first down.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs because gaining those yards keeps their turn with the ball going. This play increased their chance of winning by 6 percentage points.
pop_culture: T.Kelce is having an incredible game with his ninth catch of the night.
